title: History transition bypasses quorum approval
reasoning: The history action permits an admin to change a device's history flag from false to true without a proposal or votes. The history_activate action requires quorum approval for that same change, so an admin can bypass the intended approval requirement for a future-only device.
reproduction: Sign a history transition as an admin, preserving all other device fields while changing a future-only device's history flag to true. verify_state accepts it without votes.
recommendation: Prevent history transitions from activating future-only devices; require the history_activate approval path for that change.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No tests were included in the review context.
suggestedRegressionTest: Verify that a signed history transition changing false to true is rejected, while a valid quorum-approved history_activate transition succeeds.
minimumFixScope: Tighten the history transition validation in control.py.
